Hurrian religion.fact: A Kizzuwatnean temple of Išḫara was located on a mountain bearing her name.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: A Hurrian ritual calendar is attested in documents from _____
Hurrian religion.fact: Deities who received offering during it included "Teššub Manuzi," Lelluri, Allani, Išḫara, two manifestations of Nupatik (pibithi - "of Pibid(a)" and zalmathi - "of Zalman(a)/Zalmat") and the Anatolian goddess Maliya. Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: Some Hurrian month names, including a possible cognate of Attanašwe, _____, are also known from Alalakh
Hurrian religion.fact: Some Hurrian month names, including a possible cognate of Attanašwe, Atanatim, are also known from Alalakh.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: It is possible that _____šwe, "month of the fathers," was connected to the cult of deceased ancestors, which is well documented in Nuzi
Hurrian religion.fact: The Hurrian month names in Nuzi were Impurtanni, Arkuzzi, Kurilli, Šeḫali ša dIM (the logogram stands for the name of the god Teššub, while šeḫali might mean "festival"), Šeḫali ša Nergal, Attanašwe, Šeḫlu (followed by a month whose name is not preserved), Ḫuru, Mitirunni (mitirunnu was a festival involving a parade of divine statues) and Ḫutalši. Some Hurrian month names, including a possible cognate of Attanašwe, Atanatim, are also known from Alalakh.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: The Hurrian term referring to the concept of a divine Earth and _____ was eše hawurni
Hurrian religion.fact: It mentions that the separation of heaven and earth occurred in the distant past, at the beginning of time. The Hurrian term referring to the concept of a divine Earth and Heaven was eše hawurni.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: It has been argued that figures number 28 and 29 from the Yazılıkaya reliefs, a pair of bull-men, are holding a symbol of _____ and standing on a symbol of Earth
Hurrian religion.fact: It has been argued that figures number 28 and 29 from the Yazılıkaya reliefs, a pair of bull-men, are holding a symbol of Heaven and standing on a symbol of Earth.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: Hurrians also believed in the underworld, which they referred to as the "_____" (timri eže)
Hurrian religion.fact: Hurrians also believed in the underworld, which they called the "Dark Earth" (timri eže).

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: It was ruled by the goddess _____, whose name means "queen" or "lady" in Hurrian
Hurrian religion.fact: It was ruled by the goddess Allani, whose name means "queen" or "lady" in Hurrian.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.fact: The determination of each person's fate by Hutena and Hutellura took place in the underworld as well.

Hurrian religion.fact: The origin of those deities was not homogeneous: some were Mesopotamian in origin (for example Anu, Enlil and their spouses), while others have names which do not show an affinity with any known language.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.fact: The primordial gods appear to be absent from known Mittani documents.

Hurrian religion.fact: The myths usually understood as forming the Kumarbi Cycle are the Song of Kumarbi, Song of LAMMA, Song of Silver, Song of Ḫedammu and Song of Ullikummi.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.fact: Examples from outside this conventional grouping include Song of Ea and the Beast, a myth dealing with the primordial deity Eltara, and myths about struggle with the personified sea.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.fact: They are conventionally called "cycle," but Alfonso Archi points out that this term might be inadequate, as evidently a large number of myths about the struggle between Teššub and Kumarbi existed, and while interconnected, they could all function on their own as well. Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

Hurrian religion.fact: The birth of Aranzaḫ is not described in detail.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society
Hurrian religion.question: The rest of the narrative is poorly preserved, but Teššub does not yet become the king of the gods even though he apparently dethroned _____
Hurrian religion.fact: The procedure is apparently performed by the god Ea, and subsequently the fate goddesses arrive to repair Kumarbi's skull. Kumarbi apparently wants to instantly destroy Teššub, but he is tricked into eating a basalt stone instead and the weather god survives.

Hurrian religion.subject: Indian Society

He curses Ea because of this, but one of his bulls rebukes him for it because of the potential negative consequences, though it is not clear whether he considers him a particularly dangerous ally of Kumarbi or a neutral party who should not be antagonized.

Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Prior to the Battle of Karbala, Muslims were divided into two factions largely over the issue of succession to the Prophet: whether Ali was Muhammad's designated successor, or whether the prophet appointed no successor and had left the matter to the community. Karbala gave the Alids their own religious identity and played a significant role in the development and consolidation of what became Shia Islam.

Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Every year on this day, over 35 million people in Karbala alone commemorate Husayn's death. The Imam Husayn Shrine in Karbala, Iraq, is a profoundly holy site in Shia Islam.

Husayn and his companions are widely regarded as martyrs by all Muslims.

Husayn ibn Ali.question: While rooted in _____, the Arba'in pilgrimage has emerged as a symbol of interfaith engagement
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: While rooted in Shia Islam, the Arba'in pilgrimage has emerged as a symbol of interfaith engagement.

Husayn ibn Ali.question: Madelung notes that numerous narrations showing _____'s love for Hasan and Husayn, such as carrying them on his shoulders or putting them on his chest and kissing them on their bellies
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The family formed from the marriage of Ali and Fatima was praised many times by Muhammad. In events such as Mubahala and the hadith of the Ahl al-Kisa, Muhammad referred to this family as the Ahl al-bayt.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Madelung believes that some of these reports imply a slight preference of _____ for Hasan over Husayn, or pointing out that Hasan was more similar to his grandfather
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In events such as Mubahala and the hadith of the Ahl al-Kisa, Muhammad referred to this family as the Ahl al-bayt. Madelung notes that numerous narrations showing Muhammad's love for Hasan and Husayn, such as carrying them on his shoulders or putting them on his chest and kissing them on their bellies.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Muhammad: "Hasan and Husayn are the masters of the youth of _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: A widely reported hadith in the canonical Sunni collection Sunan al-Tirmidhi, attributed to Muhammad, states Hasan and Husayn as the sayyids (“chiefs”) of the youth of Paradise. Muhammad: "Hasan and Husayn are the masters of the youth of Paradise.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society

Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Indeed, Husayn is the Lamp of Guidance and the Ark of Salvation." Sayyid Shabāb Ahl al-Jannah is an epithet used to refer to each of Muhammad's grandsons.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: It is also narrated that _____ took Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn under his cloak and called them Ahl al-bayt and stated that they are free from any sin and pollution
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Indeed, Husayn is the Lamp of Guidance and the Ark of Salvation." Sayyid Shabāb Ahl al-Jannah is an epithet used to refer to each of Muhammad's grandsons. It is also narrated that Muhammad took Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn under his cloak and called them Ahl al-bayt and stated that they are free from any sin and pollution.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Except for _____, Ali and Hasan, they had said the same thing

Muhammad reported the Karbala incident on several occasions; For example, he gave a small bottle of soil to Umm Salama and told her that the soil inside the bottle would turn into blood after Husayn was killed.

Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Ali also knew that Husayn would be killed in Karbala, and once he passed by this area, he stopped and cried and remembered the news of Muhammad. He interpreted Karbala (کربلا) as (کرب) anguish and (بلا) calamity.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He interpreted _____ (کربلا) as (کرب) anguish and (بلا) calamity
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Ali also knew that Husayn would be killed in Karbala, and once he passed by this area, he stopped and cried and remembered the news of Muhammad. He interpreted Karbala (کربلا) as (کرب) anguish and (بلا) calamity.

Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Most of the Sunni narrations quoted by al-Tabari do not name the participants.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Other Sunni historians mention _____, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn as having participated in the Mubahala, and some Sunnis agree with the Shia tradition that Ali was among them
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: After likening Jesus' miraculous birth to Adam's creation — who was born to neither a mother nor a father— and when the Christians did not accept the Islamic doctrine about Jesus, Muhammad reportedly received a revelation instructing him to call them to Mubahala, where each party should ask God to destroy the false party and their families: If anyone dispute with you in this matter [concerning Jesus] after the knowledge which has come to you, say: Come let us call our sons and your sons, our ...

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Thus the title, the _____ of the Cloak, is related sometimes to the Event of Mubahala
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Thus the title, the Family of the Cloak, is related sometimes to the Event of Mubahala.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: During the time of _____, he defended Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, who had preached against some of the actions of the tyrants and was to be exiled from Medina
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: During the time of Uthman, he defended Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, who had preached against some of the actions of the tyrants and was to be exiled from Medina. According to several narrations, Ali asked Hasan and Husayn to defend the third Caliph during the Assassination of Uthman and carry water to him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Another report says that _____ asked Ali's help
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: During the time of Uthman, he defended Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, who had preached against some of the actions of the tyrants and was to be exiled from Medina. According to several narrations, Ali asked Hasan and Husayn to defend the third Caliph during the Assassination of Uthman and carry water to him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to several narrations, Ali asked Hasan and Husayn to defend the third Caliph during the _____ of Uthman and carry water to him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to several narrations, Ali asked Hasan and Husayn to defend the third Caliph during the Assassination of Uthman and carry water to him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to _____, when Hasan entered Uthman's house, Uthman was already assassinated
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to Vaglieri, when Hasan entered Uthman's house, Uthman was already assassinated.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn demurred, so _____ sent him back
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Another report says that Uthman asked Ali's help. Then Uthman asked Husayn if he was able to defend himself against rebels.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to a report by _____, Husayn was among Ali's major supporters who were cursed in public by the order of Mu'awiya
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to a report by Tabari, Husayn was among Ali's major supporters who were cursed in public by the order of Mu'awiya.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Madelung believes that Husayn did not recognize this treaty at first, but pressed by _____, accepted it
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: After the assassination of Ali, people gave allegiance to Hasan. To avoid the agonies of the civil war, Hasan signed a treaty with Mu'awiya I, according to which Mu'awiya would not name a successor during his reign, and let the Islamic community (ummah) choose his successor.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: After signing the peace treaty with _____, Mu'awiyah delivered a sermon in Kufa in which he declared that he had violated all the provisions of the treaty and also insulted Ali
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: To avoid the agonies of the civil war, Hasan signed a treaty with Mu'awiya I, according to which Mu'awiya would not name a successor during his reign, and let the Islamic community (ummah) choose his successor. Madelung believes that Husayn did not recognize this treaty at first, but pressed by Hasan, accepted it.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn wanted to respond, but _____ refused to do so, and Hasan delivered a sermon in response
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Madelung believes that Husayn did not recognize this treaty at first, but pressed by Hasan, accepted it. After signing the peace treaty with Hasan, Mu'awiyah delivered a sermon in Kufa in which he declared that he had violated all the provisions of the treaty and also insulted Ali.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn then left Kufa for _____ along with Hasan and Abdullah ibn Ja'far
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn then left Kufa for Medina along with Hasan and Abdullah ibn Ja'far. In the nine-year period between Hasan's abdication in AH 41 (660) and his death in AH 49 (669), Hasan and Husayn retreated to Medina, trying to keep aloof from political involvement for or against Mu'awiya.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He adhered to the terms of the treaty even after _____'s death
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: After signing the peace treaty with Hasan, Mu'awiyah delivered a sermon in Kufa in which he declared that he had violated all the provisions of the treaty and also insulted Ali. Husayn wanted to respond, but Hasan refused to do so, and Hasan delivered a sermon in response.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: After the death of Hasan, when _____ turned to Husayn, concerning an uprising, Husayn instructed them to wait as long as Mu'awiya was alive due to Hasan's peace treaty with him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: After the death of Hasan, when Kufans turned to Husayn, concerning an uprising, Husayn instructed them to wait as long as Mu'awiya was alive due to Hasan's peace treaty with him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Meanwhile, _____ reported to Mu'awiya the frequent visits of Shias to Husayn
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The burial of Hasan's body near that of Muhammad, was another problem which could have led to bloodshed, as Marwan ibn al-Hakam swore that he would not permit Hasan to be buried near Muhammad with Abu Bakr and Umar, while Uthman was buried in the Baqi Cemetery. Meanwhile, Marwan reported to Mu'awiya the frequent visits of Shias to Husayn.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Before his death in _____ 680, Mu'awiya cautioned Yazid that Husayn might challenge his rule and instructed him to defeat him if they did
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Before his death in April 680, Mu'awiya cautioned Yazid that Husayn might challenge his rule and instructed him to defeat him if they did.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Yazid was further advised to treat Husayn with caution and not to spill his blood, since he was _____'s grandson
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Yazid was further advised to treat Husayn with caution and not to spill his blood, since he was Muhammad's grandson.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Yazid's concern was especially about his two rivals in the caliphate, Husayn and _____ ibn al-Zubayr who had previously renounced allegiance
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Yazid's concern was especially about his two rivals in the caliphate, Husayn and Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr who had previously renounced allegiance.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Marwan ibn al-Hakam told Walid to imprison or behead him, but due to Husayn's kinship with _____, Walid was unwilling to take any action against him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Marwan ibn al-Hakam told Walid to imprison or behead him, but due to Husayn's kinship with Muhammad, Walid was unwilling to take any action against him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: A few days later, Husayn left for _____ without acknowledging Yazid
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: A few days later, Husayn left for Mecca without acknowledging Yazid. He arrived in Mecca at the beginning of May 680, and stayed there until the beginning of September.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He was accompanied by his wives, children and brothers, as well as _____'s sons
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: He was accompanied by his wives, children and brothers, as well as Hasan's sons. They were dissatisfied with Hasan's abdication and strongly resented Umayyad rule.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: While in Mecca, Husayn received letters from pro-Alids in Kufa informing him that they were tired of the _____ rule, which they considered to be oppressive, and that they had no rightful leader
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The Kufans had fought the Umayyads and their Syrian allies during the First Fitna, the five-year civil war which had set up the Umayyad Caliphate. They were dissatisfied with Hasan's abdication and strongly resented Umayyad rule.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn wrote back affirmatively that a rightful leader is the one who acts according to the _____ and promised to lead them with the right guidance
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn wrote back affirmatively that a rightful leader is the one who acts according to the Quran and promised to lead them with the right guidance.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Yazid removed Nu'man ibn _____ al-Ansari as governor of Kufa due to his inaction and installed Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, then governor of Basra, in his place
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Yazid removed Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari as governor of Kufa due to his inaction and installed Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad, then governor of Basra, in his place.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Abd Allah ibn Abbas and Abd Allah ibn al-_____ advised him not to move to Iraq, or, if he was determined, not to take women and children with him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Abd Allah ibn Abbas and Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr advised him not to move to Iraq, or, if he was determined, not to take women and children with him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Nevertheless, he offered Husayn support if he would stay in _____ and lead the opposition to Yazid from there
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Nevertheless, he offered Husayn support if he would stay in Mecca and lead the opposition to Yazid from there.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: I want to command the good and forbid the bad, and follow the tradition of my grandfather and the way of my father Ali ibn _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: I want to command the good and forbid the bad, and follow the tradition of my grandfather and the way of my father Ali ibn Abi Talib.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: On persuasion of Husayn's cousin _____ ibn Ja'far, the governor of Mecca Amr ibn Sa'id sent his brother and Ibn Ja'far after Husayn in order to assure him safety in Mecca and bring him back
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: On persuasion of Husayn's cousin Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, the governor of Mecca Amr ibn Sa'id sent his brother and Ibn Ja'far after Husayn in order to assure him safety in Mecca and bring him back.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Further on the way, he received the news of the execution of his cousin _____ and the indifference of the people of Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Further on the way, he received the news of the execution of his cousin Ibn Aqil and the indifference of the people of Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: In response to Husayn's question about the situation in Iraq, the poet _____ explicitly told him that the hearts of the Iraqi people are with you, but their swords are in the service of the Umayyads
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In response to Husayn's question about the situation in Iraq, the poet Farzadaq explicitly told him that the hearts of the Iraqi people are with you, but their swords are in the service of the Umayyads.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The news of the murder of _____ ibn Aqeel and Hani ibn Arwa was reported by travellers
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news of the murder of Muslim ibn Aqeel and Hani ibn Arwa was reported by travellers.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Upon hearing this, Husayn allowed his supporters to leave the caravan due to the depressing issues such as the betrayal of the _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Upon hearing this, Husayn allowed his supporters to leave the caravan due to the depressing issues such as the betrayal of the Kufis.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: But those who had come with Husayn from _____ did not leave him
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: But those who had come with Husayn from Mecca did not leave him.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The news from _____ showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news from Kufa showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported. The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to Kufa was no longer apt.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to _____ was no longer apt
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: The news from Kufa showed that the situation there had completely changed from what ibn Aqil had reported. The assessments made it clear to Husayn that going to Kufa was no longer apt.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: In the area of _____ or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In the area of Sharaf or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: With the weather being hot there, Husayn ordered water to be given to them and then announced his motives to the army and said: "You did not have an _____ and I became the means of uniting the ummah
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: With the weather being hot there, Husayn ordered water to be given to them and then announced his motives to the army and said: "You did not have an Imam and I became the means of uniting the ummah.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: If you support me, I will go to _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: In the area of Sharaf or Zuhsam, armies emerged from Kufa under the leadership of Hurr ibn Yazid. If you support me, I will go to Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: But if you do not want me anymore, I will return to my first place." _____ had stationed troops on the routes into Kufa
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: But if you do not want me anymore, I will return to my first place." Ibn Ziyad had stationed troops on the routes into Kufa.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn and his followers were intercepted by the vanguard of Yazid's army, about 1,000 men led by Hurr ibn Yazid, south of Kufa near _____
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn and his followers were intercepted by the vanguard of Yazid's army, about 1,000 men led by Hurr ibn Yazid, south of Kufa near Qadisiyya.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn said to them:I did not come to you until your letters were brought to me, and your messengers came to me saying, "_____ to us, for we have no imam" ..
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn said to them:I did not come to you until your letters were brought to me, and your messengers came to me saying, "Come to us, for we have no imam" ... Therefore, if you give me what you guaranteed in your covenants and sworn testimonies, I will come to your town.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Hurr responded that he would not allow Husayn to either enter Kufa or go back to _____, but that he was free to travel anywhere else he wished
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Hurr responded that he would not allow Husayn to either enter Kufa or go back to Medina, but that he was free to travel anywhere else he wished.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: Husayn's caravan started to move towards _____, and Hurr followed them
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's caravan started to move towards Qadisiyya, and Hurr followed them.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: One of Husayn's companions suggested that they attack _____ and move to the fortified village of al-Aqr
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: Husayn's caravan started to move towards Qadisiyya, and Hurr followed them. At Naynawa, Hurr received orders from Ibn Ziyad to force Husayn's caravan to halt in a desolate place without fortifications or water.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to _____ without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: At Naynawa, Hurr received orders from Ibn Ziyad to force Husayn's caravan to halt in a desolate place without fortifications or water. According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to Ibn Ziyad without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so.

Husayn ibn Ali.subject: Indian Society
Husayn ibn Ali.question: He suggested to Husayn to neither go to Kufa nor to Medina, rather write a letter to Yazid or _____ and wait for their orders, hoping to avoid this difficult situation by receiving an answer
Husayn ibn Ali.fact: According to Valiri, Hurr ordered his army to take Husayn and his companions to Ibn Ziyad without fighting and intended to persuade Husayn to do so.
